correctness_confidence.basis: The Lean 4 18-theorem kernel is rigorously verified with zero axioms (aside from standard propext and Quot.sound), 0 sorry, and 0 warnings. KOSZUL-WORDLE-CERT-1.0 provides exact rational auditing across four modes with strict JSON typing, rejecting all 57 adversarial forgeries.

novelty.basis: Combines machine-checked zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization with an exact-rational certificate auditor and an extensive empirical red-team test suite for multicolor Permutation Wordle dimension counts and Koszul complex strictness defects.

reproducibility.basis: All 16 canonical certificates are replayed deterministically via scripts in 0.050-66.09 ms with zero floating-point arithmetic, complete with reproducible Lean 4 proofs and SHA-256 integrity hashes.

rigor.basis: Exhaustive verification of exact rational arithmetic, explicit differential matrices, Farkas dual certificates for strictness failures, and evaluation ranks on V(Jn) eliminate floating-point instability completely.

significance.basis: Resolves the foundational exactness, filtration, and dimension-count core of Smithline's recent breakthrough on Multicolor Permutation Wordle with rigorous machine-checked certificates.

potential_errors: The authors explicitly scope their Lean 4 proofs away from the general-parameter mapping-cone induction Theorem 5.1 and game-theoretic Theorem 1.1, relying instead on exact-Q auditing for those aspects.
strengths: Flawless 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel with 0 sorry and 0 warnings.
Robust KOSZUL-WORDLE-CERT-1.0 exact-rational certificate auditor covering four distinct verification modes.
Comprehensive red-team audit rejecting 57/57 adversarial forgeries with zero floating-point arithmetic.
Clear scoping distinguishing machine-checked algebraic/homological proofs from exact-Q certified evaluation ranks and counterexamples.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact-rational certificate architecture for filtered Koszul complexes and multicolor Permutation Wordle dimension counts.
summary: This paper presents a rigorous machine-checked formalization and exact-rational certificate auditor for the algebraic, homological, and rank-theoretic core of Lawren Smithline's resolution of Kutin-Smithline Conjecture 4.5 on Multicolor Permutation Wordle. Featuring an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel and the KOSZUL-WORDLE-CERT-1.0 auditor enforcing strict zero-float arithmetic across four modes, the work achieves exemplary standards of verification, reproducibility, and red-team rigor.
weaknesses: The scope is intentionally restricted to finite homological and Euler-characteristic instances rather than full general parameter induction in Lean 4, though this is transparently disclosed.
